اعتزلنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلْنَا (iʕtazalnā) /iʕ.ta.zal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اُعْتُزِلْنَا (uʕtuzilnā) /uʕ.tu.zil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
